newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ahmsa reopens iron ore mine in desert.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ahmsa reopens iron ore mine in desert.

text.p: Steel giant Altos Hornos de Mexico (AHMSA) has restarted iron ore mining at La Perla in the northern desert area between the states of Chihuahua and Coahuila, the company said Monday.

La Perla mine was closed in 1991 on grounds of cost but the discovery of new reserves justified a restart investment of 40 million pesos to bring the mine back into use in January, the company added in its in-house magazine.
"The ore reserve amounts to 18.8 million tonnes of iron ore in terms of proven reserves," it said, adding that it meant the mine had a 10-year life span with a output of 1.1 million tonnes per year.
